final_label: D1 after a rewarded common a2->S2 trial (window start: rewarded D1 while belief favours S2), before ~trial 75 of the episode

with_model_outputs.label: D1 after a reward, when the agent is about to choose a2 (before ~trial 80 of the episode)
with_model_outputs.explanation: Fires only at D1 steps (never GO or D2), only when the reward input is 1 (previous trial rewarded), and almost exclusively when the agent will choose a2 on this trial (99.7% of mass; action at D1 is the agent own upcoming choice, which it computes; policy logit is at the a2-leaning bin -4.4..-1.5 for 90% of mass). The closest fully-observed version, previous trial a2 + common + rewarded, has F1 0.73 / mass recall 0.75, because the feature also fires when the agent repeats a2 after rare transitions or at the window start, so it tracks the upcoming a2 intention more than the literal history. The feature goes silent late in the episode (almost no activity after episode trial ~80), and within a window the activation drifts down slowly from trial to trial, so magnitude falls with episode time. Without the ep_trial term, F1 is 0.78 (precision 0.65). It does not fire after unrewarded trials, before a1 choices, or at GO/D2.

issues: Systematic false-positive class: the feature is silent at D1 after the agent chose a2, had a rare transition to S1 and was rewarded, then repeats a2. The predicate D1 & in_rew==1 & action==2 & ep_trial<80 & prev_action==2 & prev_common==0 has test precision 0.008 (10225 steps predicted, mass recall 0.0001). This directly contradicts the explanation's claim that the feature 'also fires when the agent repeats a2 after a rare transition'.
More generally, with prev_state==1 (the previous trial reached S1) test precision is 0.008. The feature needs the rewarded state to have been S2, not just any reward followed by an a2 choice.

This also explains the rel +1 dip that the original analysis did not account for. Core trials are balanced over the four patterns, so the trial before rel +1 is rare 50% of the time, and the original predicate's precision at rel +1 is only 0.51 on test. After excluding prev_state==1, rel +1 precision rises to 0.84.

The explanation's history predicate (previous trial a2, common, rewarded) works because a2-common means the agent reached S2. Within the original predicate it has precision 0.92 when prev_action==2 & prev_common==1. The a1-rare-to-S2-rewarded then a2 case has precision 0.50, but it is a small share of the mass (0.01). So the feature tracks 'rewarded in S2', not 'rewarded after choosing a2'.

Claims that check out: D1 only (GO and D2 have 0 active steps), needs in_rew==1 (65 active steps with in_rew==0), almost nothing before a1 (0.3% of mass), and silent from episode trial 80 on (14 active steps in trials 80-89). An ep_trial cutoff of 75 fits slightly better than 80.
Test F1 rises from 0.884 to 0.941 once prev_state==1 is excluded, and precision rises from 0.80 to 0.93, so the original label is missing a necessary condition.
skeptic.revised_label: D1 after the agent was rewarded in state S2 (or the previous trial is unknown), when it is about to choose a2 again (silent from about episode trial 75-80). Not active after a reward in S1, even if the agent then picks a2.

with_model_outputs.final_label: D1 after the agent was rewarded in state S2 (or the previous trial is unknown), when it is about to choose a2 again (silent from about episode trial 75-80). Not active after a reward in S1, even if the agent then picks a2.

label: D1 after a rewarded common a2->S2 trial (window start: rewarded D1 while belief favours S2), before ~trial 75 of the episode
explanation: Fires only at D1 steps that show a reward (in_rew == 1), almost never after a reward earned in S1, and only when the ideal-observer belief that S1 is good is below about 0.6; silent after about trial 75 of the episode. The belief threshold stands in for the banned upcoming choice of a2 and also covers window-start steps with no previous trial. Using prev_state works better than prev_action (rewarded rare a2->S1 trials do not fire). Remaining misses: some rewarded D1 steps after an unrewarded trial are inactive or weak, and some window-start steps with belief above 0.6 fire. Magnitude not analysed.

issues: The label overclaims. 'A reward that did not come from S1' suggests any S2 reward, but rewarded rare a1->S2 D1s mostly stay silent (precision 0.27 overall, 0.46 with the belief and ep_trial clauses; 0.6-1.2% of mass). In practice the feature fires after a rewarded common a2->S2 trial.

The belief < 0.6 clause does almost nothing when the previous trial is in the window: rewarded a2->S2 with ep_trial<75 has test precision 0.958 without it and 0.959 with it. Belief only matters on window-start steps, where it is weak (precision 0.64, 22% of mass).

Claims that do hold: rewarded S1 D1s are silent (precision 0.002); silent from ep_trial >= 75 (precision 0.07, 0.3% of mass). Upcoming a2 explains most of it: (in_rew==1)&(action==2)&(ep_trial<75) gives recall 0.957 and mass recall 0.995, and adding action==2 to the recorded rule lifts F1 0.915 -> 0.931.
Misses show activation fading over runs of repeated a2-S2 rewards (e.g. 0.12, 0.09, 0.06, 0.03). Magnitude is not in the label.
